purpose: Read exact setup dependencies before writing customer setup values on U-CUST-100.
businessPurpose: The customer card shows empty billing and payment setup fields. Before a write gate, Business Central must show which posting groups, VAT groups and payment terms exist and what they mean.
acceptanceCriteria: playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE is confirmed before reading setup dependencies.
No setup, master data, document, preview, posting, payment or API shortcut is changed.
The result states exact visible candidate values or explicitly says they remain unproven.
Screenshots explain what the UI shows, what the field/dropdown/list means, and what is not proven.
The result decides whether a later CUSTOMER-SETUP-VALUE-WRITE-GATE is ready, partially ready or blocked.
stopIf: The active instance or company is not clearly playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
A field interaction would save, create, confirm or change data.
A dropdown or setup page cannot be inspected without selecting a value.
The UI opens an unexpected page and Page Inspection/screenshots cannot clarify it.
